name: Yume, Omoi, Hitori.
source:
April, 2003.  
The Human Genome Project—DNA—was fully sequenced.  
Universities and corporations worldwide contributed.  
Even Tenkai City, where this story unfolds, had its player:  
Sanjo Genomics.  

Years passed.  
DNA research faded from mainstream science.  
But Sanjo kept at it.  

Then—  

Sometime, somewhere—  
"Sanjo Genomics deciphers non-coding DNA regions."  
The breakthrough gave most people an ability.  

Precognition.  

The world cheered. Sanjo became legendary.  
But hype dies.  
Only one fact remained: nearly all humans could now see the future.  

Almost all.  

Not her.  
Sanjo Mikoto—heiress to the empire—  
Couldn’t manifest the gift.  

...The have-not among haves.  

So—  

They denied her.  
Looked down on her.  
Branded her.  

Crushed from within.  
Crushed from without.  

Done.  

That’s your girl.  

The Null.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030714034138/http://www.plusworks.jp/index2.html]the official website[/url]]
